entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: An artificial metal plane that now has a fifth sun.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The being who rages against the peoples of Mirrodin and whose will bends clouds and metal.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: Youngest of the kha, believed by some to be the reincarnation of Dakan.

entities.name: Dakan
entities.description: The first and mightiest of leonin leaders.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Feline people led by a kha.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: Humans who learned perseverance from their forebears and justice from the leonin.

entities.name: Loxodon
entities.description: Elephant folk with whom Auriok and leonin failed to make peace or war.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Knowledge-seeking people who treat others as subjects of study.

entities.name: Krark Clan
entities.description: Goblin clan that tinkers and pulls myr apart.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: Fire-working people who prize blades that killed their owners.

entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: Region of Mirrodin onto which goblins pour.

entities.name: Cave of Light
entities.description: Cave visited by Auriok girls each generation.

entities.name: The fifth sun
entities.description: New sun joining Mirrodin's four, awakening abilities in its creatures.

entities.name: Cosmic Larva
entities.description: Creatures that wandered plane to plane devouring metal.

events.summary: Raksha watches goblins pour onto the Razor Fields.
events.quote: Raksha watched as the goblins continued to pour onto the Razor Fields.

events.summary: Raksha admits that even as kha she is nothing without her people.
events.quote: I may be kha, but without my soldiers, my people, I am nothing.

events.summary: Ushanti prophesies that guardians will be needed more than ever.
events.quote: If what I have seen comes to pass, we will need our guardians more than ever.

events.summary: Memnarch muses on taking Mirrodin apart and beginning again.
events.quote: Perhaps I should take Mirrodin apart and begin again.

events.summary: Memnarch threatens to wipe all memory of a foe from reality.
events.quote: All memory of your existence will be wiped from reality. You will die, and no one will mourn.

events.summary: Memnarch boasts that everything flows through him.
events.quote: It is all in my grasp.

events.summary: The fifth sun is born, seen as doom by some and salvation by others.
events.quote: To some the birth of the fifth sun was a sign of doom.

events.summary: The fifth sun joins the other four and awakens new abilities in Mirrodin's creatures.
events.quote: As the fifth sun joins the other four, new abilities awaken in the creatures of Mirrodin.

events.summary: Auriok salvagers gather scraps left by Memnarch and the vedalken.
events.quote: Memnarch or the vedalken salvage most of the large machines, leaving us only scraps.

events.summary: Cosmic larvae finally end their wandering from plane to plane.
events.quote: For millennia they wandered from plane to plane, devouring all metal.

events.summary: Geth urges mastery of the mists.
events.quote: Feel the burn of the mists. Master them. They will devour your enemies.

relations.quote: Some believe that Raksha, youngest of the kha, is the reincarnation of Dakan

relations.note: believed by some to be Dakan's reincarnation
relations.quote: Some believe that Raksha, youngest of the kha, is the reincarnation of Dakan

relations.note: Auriok vow to endure Memnarch's rage
relations.quote: Memnarch shall rage against us. We shall endure.
